objective.text: Use sometimes with required to distinguish an omitted PATCH field from an explicitly empty field.

difficulty.rationale: Allow omission while rejecting an explicitly empty replacement.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A PATCH endpoint permits omitting display_name to leave it unchanged. If supplied, it must be a nonempty string. Which rule set expresses that distinction?

options.rationale: sometimes skips an absent field; required rejects an explicitly empty value, and string constrains the supplied type.
This rejects omission even though the endpoint permits leaving the field unchanged.

options.rationale: present requires the key on every request and string alone does not reject every empty string in this context.
